```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
first_season <- 2013L
last_season <- 2025L # the 2026 season is still being played
tier_order <- c("Power", "Group of 5", "FCS and below")
tier_colors <- tier_palette()
credited <- tbl(con, "team_draft") |>
  filter(season >= first_season, season <= last_season) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(tier_label = factor(tier_label, levels = tier_order))
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: compute
# Notre Dame, a conference of one, is left to the school rankings; FBS
# players with no recorded position are left out.
fbs_pos <- credited |>
  filter(tier_label != "FCS and below", position_group != "Position not recorded") |>
  mutate(
    league = case_when(
      conference == "FBS Independents" & team == "Notre Dame" ~ "Notre Dame",
      conference == "FBS Independents" ~ "Other FBS independents",
      .default = conference
    ),
    position_group = factor(position_group, levels = position_group_levels())
  )
conf_rates <- draft_rates(group_by(fbs_pos, league)) |>
  arrange(draft_rate)
league_levels <- conf_rates$league[conf_rates$league != "Notre Dame"]
conf_pos <- draft_rates(
  group_by(filter(fbs_pos, league != "Notre Dame"), league, position_group)
) |>
  mutate(league = factor(league, levels = league_levels)) |>
  group_by(position_group) |>
  mutate(leader = draft_rate == max(draft_rate)) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
leaders <- conf_pos |>
  group_by(position_group) |>
  slice_max(draft_rate, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(draft_rate) |>
  mutate(position_group = factor(position_group, levels = position_group))
p <- ggplot(leaders, aes(draft_rate, position_group)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        league, " drafted ", pct(draft_rate), " of its ", tolower(position_group),
        " eligible players (", drafted, " of ", fmt(eligible), ")"
      ),
      data_id = position_group
    ),
    fill = "#374151",
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(league, ", ", pct(draft_rate, 0))),
    hjust = -0.05,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent,
    limits = c(0, max(leaders$draft_rate) * 1.5),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Highest conference draft rate at each position",
    subtitle = "Each bar is the leading conference's draft rate, named beside it",
    x = "Draft rate",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "conference-draft-rate-by-position", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: heatmap
p_heat <- ggplot(conf_pos, aes(position_group, league, fill = draft_rate)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        league, ", ", tolower(position_group), ": ", drafted, " drafted of ",
        fmt(eligible), " eligible (", pct(draft_rate), ")"
      ),
      data_id = paste(league, position_group)
    ),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    data = filter(conf_pos, leader),
    fill = NA,
    color = "#111827",
    linewidth = 1.6
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#f8fafc",
    high = "#374151",
    labels = scales::percent,
    name = "Draft rate"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub(" ", "\n", x), position = "top") +
  labs(
    title = "Draft rate by conference and position group",
    subtitle = "Outlined: the conference with the highest draft rate at each position",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
card_interactive(p_heat)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
tier_pos <- draft_rates(group_by(fbs_pos, position_group, tier_label)) |>
  select(position_group, tier_label, eligible, draft_rate) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = tier_label,
    values_from = c(eligible, draft_rate)
  ) |>
  mutate(ratio = draft_rate_Power / `draft_rate_Group of 5`)
tier_pos |>
  transmute(
    position = as.character(position_group),
    power_n = fmt(eligible_Power),
    power_rate = pct(draft_rate_Power),
    g5_n = fmt(`eligible_Group of 5`),
    g5_rate = pct(`draft_rate_Group of 5`),
    ratio = sprintf("%.1f", ratio)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Position group", "Power eligible", "Power draft rate",
      "Group of 5 eligible", "Group of 5 draft rate", "Power rate divided by Group of 5 rate"
    ),
    caption = sprintf(
      "Draft rates by position group and tier, final seasons %s to %s. The last column divides the Power draft rate by the Group of 5 draft rate.",
      first_season,
      last_season
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: seasons
pos_season <- draft_rates(group_by(fbs_pos, position_group, tier_label, season))
p_seasons <- ggplot(
  pos_season,
  aes(season, draft_rate, color = tier_label, group = tier_label)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        position_group, ", ", tier_label, ", ", season, ": ", drafted,
        " drafted of ", eligible, " eligible (", pct(draft_rate), ")"
      ),
      data_id = paste(position_group, tier_label, season)
    ),
    size = 2.2
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~position_group, ncol = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = tier_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(first_season, 2019L, last_season)) +
  labs(
    x = "Final college season",
    y = "Draft rate",
    title = "Draft rate by position, tier and season",
    subtitle = "Hover a point for counts",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 14)
card_interactive(p_seasons)
```
